scope: DOM event normalization for exactly one dedicated textarea. Pure fake-element/event tests here; actual DOM/UI/native IME operations owned by parent. No widget, clipboard API, other app, global key listener, network, storage or OS acquisition.

receiver.bodyOwnership: Only receiver creates body/IDs. Adapter stores producer document/preedit and at most one frozen pending event, never another material body/allocator.

interface: adapter.mjs exports createAdapter({element,clock,ink='blue',bodyLimit=256,shapeMode='inline'}), singleDiff(before,after). Adapter methods handle(event),advance(at),setInk(ink),setAdmissionReady(bool,at),retry(at),readBody(),snapshot(),exportState(),inspectVolatile(),destroy(),setVisible(bool,at),setPaused(bool,at),shapeRequest(),answerShape(token,at). readBody delegates readonly ephemeral receiver projection; inspectVolatile is nonpersistent test inspection, never an export/log.
binding: Element must be a textarea. Listen only on it for beforeinput/input/compositionstart/update/end/keydown/blur. Target strict equality precedes reading value/data. Initial value bounded512UTF16 is a baseline, never material. No existing baseline import.
evidence: isTrusted===true is a local UA-delivery guard, not OS/IME authentication. R3 synthetic-commit vocabulary is used as an editor-local producer declaration, not proof of general IME confirmation. Fake tests declaring true are synthetic assertions, not browser observations. Source/session registry remains lab.
knownOrdinary: Trusted matching beforeinput/input inputType pair, both noncomposing, same bounded stable original document and safe captured selection. Insert expected prefix/suffix around original range must exactly match observed final value. insertText requires matching declared data; insertLineBreak uses newline; paste/replacement may derive inserted text from DOM value when data null. No clipboardData/dataTransfer/getTargetRanges access. Known insert types insertText/insertLineBreak/insertFromPaste/insertReplacementText.
historyDelete: Trusted historyUndo/historyRedo use one exact UTF16 contiguous diff against stable original revision, no new material under receiver history rules. Known deleteContentBackward/deleteContentForward/deleteWordBackward/deleteWordForward/deleteByCut/deleteContent require no inserted text. Exact observed diff updates document; body IDs/inks are historical and never regenerated.
composition: Trusted start captures bounded stable original document/selection/ink and a lifecycle ID. Updates and input while lifecycle active remain preedit, even isComposing=false before end. Trusted compositionend is not sufficient alone: nonempty bounded data must replace captured range and exactly match final DOM value. If end precedes final input, retain one ended token and wait for trusted noncomposing input of insertText/insertFromComposition/insertCompositionText matching expected value. Cancel empty data, missing lifecycle, untrusted/mismatched end, unknown event order or expiry adds0. A following unchanged input echo has no new operation. No quiet/keydown/Enter confirmation inference.
rangeIdentity: Do not normalize NFC. Preserve original UTF16 offsets; reject surrogate-split selections and unpaired surrogate text. Insertions within one recognized operation use original selected range, even identical text replacement; this is a new serial and can add another same-text unit. Minimal diff is only for observations/history/deletion, not a guess of confirmed material.
unknown: Observe a bounded exact document diff or baseline with document-only quality. Unknown composition/preedit adds no material. Missing beforeinput/trust/recognizedtype, prefix/suffix mismatch, unsafe text or cancelled/missing end cannot be upgraded by time. Overlimit value is not retained by adapter; show document-limit and keep accepted body.
backpressure: Each normalized event is recursively copied/frozen. Temporary noACK holds one frozen event, leaves stable doc/version/serial unchanged and makes own textarea readOnly. Same proposed DOM value echo is ignored, retry uses original observedAt and identical event. Different value during pending discloses unsupported-overrun via a newer editor seq, abandons the slot and never auto-rebases append provenance. Normal baseline cannot repair unsupported source. Permanent whole hold advances valid mirror observation/serial and exposes reason, added0; reveal does not free body capacity.
color: Ink captured at beforeinput or compositionstart for that operation; subsequent ink changes do not rewrite historical or pending units. Four enums white/blue/green/purple.
async: handle/addition is synchronous and awaits no shape answer. Receiver inline/deferred limited lexical shape modes are independent. A never-resolving shape request must not block accepted letters. No actual model/network calls.
privacy: Raw text exists only in own textarea and bounded volatile producer/receiver/projection state. No console/raw event log, localStorage/sessionStorage/indexedDB/fetch/sendBeacon. exportState uses receiver saving-off recursive allowlist; no text/IDs/color order/doc/preedit/query/fingerprint. Page status is nontext aggregate; body projection is volatile by receiver IDs.
clock: Monotonic integer local clock. Expiry cancels preedit/before token or ended token as unknown; never commits. Hidden/pause controls suppress receiver interpretation/reveal; own-page material admission remains bounded.
evaluation: AI manual frozen cases, fake DOM facts only. No human annotation/native/UI/real IME claims. Source fixes after results are separately labelled regression and originals preserved. Root owns actual DOM actions and Git/shared docs. Independent reviewer freezes separate expectations without author source/results.
